'''Agnuk''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was member of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunter's Guild]]. He was a student of the [[Orsis Academy]] when he was young. Later he joined the Bounty Hunter's Guild as a bounty hunter. At some point during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], he traveled with his son [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]] to [[Longwind]]. There he found [[Kindro Nimmel|Jedi Kindro Nimmel]]. Agnuk attacked him and broke the Jedi's [[Limb/Legends|arm]], though Nimmel ultimately succeeded at [[Death/Legends|killing]] his assailant. Moments later, Cradossk stumbled across his father's corpse and in a rage, he sprang on Nimmel and broke his legs, then sank his [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] into the Jedi's neck and murdered him. Cradossk later wrote about his encounter with Nimmel in his autobiography ''[[Making a Killing]]''.<ref name="Files of Boba Fett" />
